question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Amplify
solution:
The correct answer is: **Contract**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amplify"** means to make something larger, more intense, or more powerful. (विस्तारित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The microphone was used to amplify her voice during the speech.
 
 
 
• **"Contract"** refers to making something smaller or less extensive. (संकुचित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The muscle will contract when you flex your arm.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'amplify'** is **'contract'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Contract**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enlarge **(बड़ा करना): To make something bigger or more extensive.

 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to enlarge its office space next year.
 
 
 
• **Exert **(प्रयास करना): To apply force or effort.
 
 
• **Example: **He had to exert a lot of effort to lift the heavy box.
 
 
 
• **Defy** (अवहेलना करना): To openly resist or refuse to obey.
 
 
• **Example:** The protesters decided to defy the government orders.
